title: Right Management Named One of America's Best Management Consulting Firms 2026 by Forbes and Statista
summary: The Investor Relations website contains information about ManpowerGroup Inc.'s business for stockholders, potential investors, and financial analysts.
body_markdown:
*Recognition reflects Right Management's expertise in helping organizations navigate workforce transformation through career transition, leadership development, and coaching*


MILWAUKEE


, Oct. 19, 2026


/PRNewswire/ --[Talent Solutions Right Management](https://edge.prnewswire.com/c/link/?t=0&l=en&o=4800850-1&h=2375285655&u=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.right.com%2Fen%2F%3Futm_source%3Dpress-release%26utm_medium%3Dpr%26utm_campaign%3Drm_us_b2b_forbes-award_2026&a=Talent+Solutions%C2%A0Right+Management) , part of the[ManpowerGroup](https://edge.prnewswire.com/c/link/?t=0&l=en&o=4800850-1&h=2486463019&u=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.manpowergroup.com%2F%3Futm_source%3Dpress-release%26utm_medium%3Dpr%26utm_campaign%3Drm_us_b2b_forbes-award_2026&a=ManpowerGroup) family of brands, has been recognized on the Forbes list of America's Best Management Consulting Firms 2026. This distinguished honor is presented by Forbes and Statista.


The America's Best Management Consulting Firms list highlights leading consultancies across the United States, based on comprehensive data from both expert and client evaluations.


The recognition reinforces Right Management's position as a trusted workforce transformation partner. Through career transition, leadership development, coaching, talent management, and internal mobility solutions, Right Management helps organizations navigate change, strengthen workforce resilience, and create opportunities for their people to succeed.


"Workforce transformation requires organizations to balance business priorities with the needs and potential of their people," said Patrick McCue, Americas Sales and Client Experience Leader at Right Management. "This recognition reflects the expertise and commitment our teams bring to helping clients navigate that challenge. It strengthens our resolve to deliver career transition, leadership development and coaching solutions that help organizations and individuals prepare for what comes next."


America's Best Management Consulting Firms 2026 was developed using a two-part methodology:


- **Expert Survey:** More than 10,000 partners and executives were invited to recommend consulting firms across 16 client sectors and 17 functional areas.
- **Client Survey:** Over 1,250 clients were asked to assess management consultancies they have engaged with over the past four years. Respondents identified the industries and functional areas of collaboration, then reviewed a shortlist for each category built from prior-year results and new expert recommendations. Self-nominations were not permitted.


The recognition reflects the trust business and people leaders place in Right Management and the impact their experts and coaches help create. As workforce transformation continues to reshape organizations, Right Management remains committed to helping organizations build stronger leaders, support career mobility, manage workforce transitions, and prepare their talent strategies for the future.


To learn more about Right Management's workforce transformation, career transition, leadership development, and coaching solutions, visit[Right.com](https://edge.prnewswire.com/c/link/?t=0&l=en&o=4800850-1&h=3128864843&u=https%3A%2F%2Fright.com%2Fen%2F%3Futm_source%3Dpress-release%26utm_medium%3Dpr%26utm_campaign%3Drm_us_b2b_forbes-award_2026&a=Right.com) .
